angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 946,152 km at 445.01 pc = 0.03 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 2.2472 +/- 0.0133 mas (same row, RUWE 1.04): 445.01 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.36 +/- 0.064 solar radii from Oberst et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of KELT-16 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153...97O/abstract): 946,152 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.211 +/- 0.043 solar masses from Oberst et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of KELT-16 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153...97O/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6236 +/- 54 K from Oberst et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of KELT-16 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153...97O/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Oberst et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of KELT-16 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153...97O/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/kelt-16.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.254, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-16 (pscomppars): spectral type F7 V, from Oberst et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153...97O/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, KELT-16: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-16 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.002 dex, from Oberst et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153...97O/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-16 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.4014, from Oberst et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153...97O/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-16 (pscomppars): age 3.1 Gyr, from Oberst et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153...97O/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-16 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 7.6 km/s, from Oberst et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153...97O/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
